_comment: Single source of truth for EC2 pricing used to derive cost-per-token / cost-per-task. Update dollars_per_hour here and regenerate the throughput summaries + README chart; do not hardcode prices in scripts. A model served at TP < gpus_per_instance uses only a fraction of the box, so its effective rate is dollars_per_hour * tp / gpus_per_instance (see pricing.py resolve()). Rates below are committed-capacity, not on-demand: p5en.48xlarge is a Capacity Reservation (CR) rate; g6e.12xlarge is a 1-year Reserved Instance (RI) rate. See _rate_basis for each.
source: Committed-capacity pricing (Capacity Reservation / 1-year Reserved Instance), us-east-1, Linux
